title: Regulated – consent required, transcript not retained
description: For meetings where consent has to come first and as little meeting content as possible is kept. Nothing is recorded or transcribed until consent is given: Meeting Consent mode Opt-in with the each-participant rule, a meeting may only use this mode or a stricter one, streaming clients without a consent step are refused, the Virtual Participant leaves after an objection, and evidence screenshots are kept. Consent is not each participant's own reply everywhere. From Stream Audio and the Desktop Capture App it is the meeting owner's attestation that everyone agreed. A Virtual Participant on a join that cannot match consent replies to participants (Teams in the browser, Webex and Google Meet) never meets the each-participant rule, and a meeting cannot switch to the less strict owner-attests rule, so such a meeting is not transcribed. See "What each platform supports" in docs/meeting-consent.md. The transcript is deleted 15 minutes after the summary is written, meeting audio is not recorded, personal information is redacted from transcripts (in en-US, en-AU, en-GB and es-US), the meeting chat is not added to the transcript, and Amazon Bedrock models run within this deployment's geography. Every other setting stays as it is. Some controls are stack parameters rather than settings, so they are not part of any profile and have to be set when the stack is deployed or updated: LogLevel (INFO or WARN; DEBUG logs meeting content), the retention periods MeetingRecordExpirationInDays, TranscriptionExpirationInDays, AudioRecordingExpirationInDays and CloudWatchLogsExpirationInDays, and EnableVideoRecording (meeting video from the Virtual Participant and the Desktop Capture App). See "Where meeting content is processed" in docs/infrastructure-and-security.md.
